neumann_bc_xmin.description: Nonzero-Neumann ghost-cell prescription at xmin for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (esm-spec §9.2 / §11.5; ESS BC kind/side matcher via the fn/dim encoding landed in ess-bps/ess-tox, G8). The `value` is the outward normal derivative du/dn at the boundary. ESS's `_discretize_bc!` builds the synthetic `bc` wrapper encoding kind->fn, side->dim, variable->arg, value->arg, then runs the rule engine; the fn/dim sibling fields are matched by `_match_sibling_name`. At xmin the outward normal is -x, so the one-sided difference across the boundary face gives u_ghost = u[1] + h*value (1-based first interior cell u[1]; reduces to the homogeneous-Neumann ghost u[1] of zero_gradient_bc_xmin when value=0). `$h = 1/N` is bound for the side's spatial dim by `bind_side_spacing` (`var_has_grid` first resolves the variable's grid). Analytic check: (u_ghost - u[1])/h = value = du/dn (outward, -x face).

neumann_bc_xmax.description: Nonzero-Neumann ghost-cell prescription at xmax: the high-side ghost reflects the last interior cell plus the prescribed flux, u_ghost = u[N] + h*value (1-based, N bound from the grid via `bind_side_dim_size`; reduces to the homogeneous-Neumann ghost u[N] of zero_gradient_bc_xmax when value=0). At xmax the outward normal is +x, so du/dn = (u_ghost - u[N])/h = value. `var_has_grid` binds the variable's grid so `bind_side_dim_size` resolves N and `bind_side_spacing` resolves $h = 1/N for the xmax axis.
